families.family: activation forward (21 activations via constexpr act_func switch, dropout=False)
families.reference: {'sigmoid':torch.sigmoid,'logsigmoid':F.logsigmoid,'tanh':torch.tanh,'relu':F.relu,'gelu':F.gelu(x),'geluapprox':F.gelu(x,approximate='tanh'),'silu':F.silu,'relu6':F.relu6,'hardsigmoid':F.hardsigmoid,'hardtanh':F.hardtanh(x,-1.,1.),'hardswish':F.hardswish,'selu':F.selu,'mish':F.mish,'softplus':F.softplus(x,beta=1,threshold=20),'softsign':F.softsign,'tanhshrink':F.tanhshrink,'leaky_relu':F.leaky_relu(x,param),'elu':F.elu(x,param),'celu':F.celu(x,param),'hardshrink':F.hardshrink(x,param),'softshrink':F.softshrink(x,param)}[act_func](x)
families.notes: Flat 1D elementwise over size elems; param is a runtime scalar parsed from 'name_PARAM' strings in the layer. Code-visible deviations (fp32 math): softplus=log(1+exp(x)) has no threshold -> inf for x>~88.7 (torch returns x); logsigmoid=log(sigmoid(x)) -> -inf/underflow for x<~-88 (torch ~x); tanh=2*sigmoid(2x)-1 has ~1e-7 absolute error so large relative error for |x|<~1e-4, tanhshrink=x-tanh(x) suffers catastrophic cancellation near 0. relu/relu6/hard*/softsign/leaky/shrink computed in input dtype; others upcast to fp32. Hardtanh layer only allows min=-1,max=1; Softplus layer has no beta/threshold args. In-place args ignored (warning).

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(act(x), x, grad_output) with act as in the forward family
families.notes: Also launched by Linear and BatchNorm backward to differentiate the fused activation w.r.t. saved pre-activation. Subgradient conventions match torch (relu'(0)=0, leaky'(0)=slope, elu'(0)=alpha, hardsigmoid/hardtanh/relu6 open intervals, hardshrink/softshrink 0 on |x|<=lambd). Deviations: mish_grad uses exp(x)^4 terms -> inf/inf=NaN for x>~22 in fp32 (torch ~1); tanh-based grads inherit tanh precision near 0.

families.reference: torch.where(m, 0, act(x)/(1-p)) with m = tl.rand(seed, flat_offset) < p
families.notes: Same kernel, constexpr dropout=True (training and drop_p>0). Deterministic check: conditional on mask m (recover from zeros where act(x)!=0, or regenerate Philox tl.rand(seed, element index), independent of BLOCK_SIZE) the kept values must equal act(x)/(1-p); dropped fraction ~p. Seed = python randint(0,65535).

families.reference: torch.where(m, 0, g/(1-p)) * act'(x), m regenerated from same (seed, offset)
families.notes: Deterministic check: mask must coincide with forward mask for the same seed; given mask, gradient is exact autograd of forward.

families.reference: torch.where(m, 0, x/(1-p)), m = tl.rand(seed, flat_offset) < p
families.notes: Kernel only launched for training and 0<p<1 (p==0/eval returns input, p==1 returns zeros in Python). Deterministic check: kept elems == x/(1-p) exactly up to rounding; zero fraction ~p; same seed reproduces same mask.

families.reference: torch.where(m, 0, g/(1-p)) with the forward's mask
families.notes: Mask regenerated from (seed, offset); check equality with forward mask.

families.reference: a, b = x.chunk(2, dim); a * act(b)   (act='sigmoid' == F.glu(x, dim))
families.notes: Kernel receives the two halves as separate contiguous buffers (first half = value, second half = gate, matching torch.glu). act/param as in activation family, no dropout; inherits activation numerical deviations.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(a*act(b), (a, b), g)
families.notes: Writes separate grads for both halves; layer concatenates along dim.

families.reference: neg=False,log=False: torch.softmax(x,-1); log=True: F.log_softmax(x,-1); neg=True: F.softmin(x,-1); neg&log: F.log_softmax(-x,-1)
families.notes: 2D [batch, feat] view, whole row in one block (BLOCK_SIZE_FEAT=next_pow2(feat_dim)) so very wide rows may fail to compile/spill. Fully -inf row -> NaN (same as torch). fp32 math; output fp32 under autocast else input dtype. Layers reject dim != last.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(forward_ref(x), x, g)
families.notes: Takes the saved forward output (not x) as input; reference should feed y=forward_ref(x).

families.reference: F.layer_norm(x, (D,), weight, bias, eps)  (+ optional stats: mean=x.mean(-1), rstd=1/sqrt(x.var(-1,unbiased=False)+eps))
families.notes: Normalizes last dim only (normalized_shape must be int). bias is ignored when weight is None (add_bias requires scale_by_weight) - differs from F.layer_norm(x,(D,),None,b). Output fp32 under AMP unless autocast_to_fp32=False (documented). Whole row per block.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.layer_norm(x,(D,),w,b,eps), (x,w,b), g)
families.notes: Consumes saved mean/rstd. dW/db written as per-program partial sums of shape [cdiv(B,BLOCK_SIZE_BATCH), D], summed in Python; check after sum.

families.reference: F.rms_norm(x, (D,), weight, eps)  with eps=None -> torch.finfo(x.dtype).eps (same default as torch)
families.notes: Optionally saves inv_rms. Last dim only.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.rms_norm(x,(D,),w,eps), (x,w), g)
families.notes: dW partial sums per program, summed in Python.

families.family: batch_norm forward with residual add and fused activation
families.reference: act(F.batch_norm(x, running_mean, running_var, weight, bias, training=(is_train or not track_running_stats), momentum=momentum, eps=eps) + residual)  (running stats updated in place with unbiased var when is_train and track_running_stats)
families.notes: One program per channel, streaming Welford merge (verified algebraically correct); input viewed [N,C,S] and transposed to [S,C,N] when S>1. Deviations: momentum=None (cumulative average) unsupported; num_batches_tracked not incremented; affine requires both weight and bias; N*S==1 in training -> div by zero in n/(n-1) (torch raises). Masked loads have no `other` and tl.sum(curr_input) relies on zero-fill. Whole first-axis block loaded at once (BLOCK_SIZE_BATCH=next_pow2). Saves pre-activation for backward. autotune restores running stats between trials.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.batch_norm(x,None,None,w,b,training=True,eps=eps), (x,w,b), pre_act_grad)
families.notes: Activation grad computed first by act_func_backward_kernel; residual grad = pre_act_grad. Formula is batch-statistics gradient only. Deviation: in eval mode with track_running_stats, forward never writes mean/inv_std (left torch.empty) and backward still applies batch-stat formula -> garbage/wrong grads (correct would be w*rstd_running*g).

families.family: linear forward with bias and fused activation
families.reference: act(x @ W + b) == act(F.linear(x, W.T, b)), W stored [in_features, out_features]
families.notes: Weight layout is transposed vs torch (documented). tf32 heuristic = cc>=8, so fp32 inputs use TF32 dot on A6000 (~1e-3 rel error); fp16 path when autocast. Pre-activation saved when grad needed. K-dim masked loads without other rely on zero-fill. Linear backward matmuls run in torch (no Triton kernel).

families.reference: F.conv2d(x, w, None, stride=(sh,sw), padding=(ph,pw), dilation=1, groups=groups); pools: F.avg_pool2d(x, k, stride, padding, ceil_mode=False, count_include_pad=True)
families.notes: Direct (implicit GEMM) conv, zero padding, dilation 1 only; bias added in Python afterwards (comment: in-kernel bias buggy with groups). TF32 on cc>=8. Pools implemented as depthwise conv with constant 1/k weights cached on first call (channel count/dtype of first input). Backward uses torch.nn.grad (no Triton). README: attorch.nn exposes torch convs instead because these are slow.

families.reference: F.cross_entropy(x, t, weight=w, reduction='mean')  for 2D x [B,C], all t in [0,C)
families.notes: Only reduction='mean', no label smoothing, no ignore_index (module does not raise for ignore_index; target -100 -> out-of-bounds read). Writes per-program partial sums (and sum of weights) reduced in Python. BUG: output buffer has floor(B/BLOCK_SIZE_BATCH) entries but grid is cdiv; when feat_dim<64, B>=2048 and B % BLOCK_SIZE_BATCH != 0 the last program writes out of bounds and its rows are dropped (its block sum would also be NaN since masked rows load -inf).

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.cross_entropy(x,t,weight=w), x, g)
families.notes: Uses sum_weights from forward; same target-domain restriction.

families.family: nll_loss forward (none/mean/sum, optional class weights, arbitrary spatial dims)
families.reference: F.nll_loss(x, t, weight=w, reduction=reduction)  with all t in [0,C)
families.notes: ignore_index unsupported (documented, silently ignored). Spatial dims flattened and processed in one block (next_pow2(spatial_dim)). Same floor-vs-cdiv partial-sum bug as cross_entropy for reduction!='none' when spatial_dim<64, B>=2048, B % BLOCK_SIZE_BATCH != 0.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.nll_loss(x,t,weight=w,reduction=r), x, g)
families.notes: Scatters into a zero-initialized input_grad (wrapper zeros it).

families.family: pointwise regression loss forward (smooth L1 / L1 / MSE / Huber via constexpr p_loss)
families.reference: {0: F.smooth_l1_loss(x,t,reduction=r,beta=param), 1: F.l1_loss(x,t,reduction=r), 2: F.mse_loss(x,t,reduction=r), 3: F.huber_loss(x,t,reduction=r,delta=param)}[p_loss]
families.notes: Flattened; per-program partial sums reduced in Python using autotuner best_config BLOCK_SIZE. No broadcasting between input and target.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(loss_ref(x,t), (x,t), g)
families.notes: Deviation: L1 (and smooth L1 with beta=0) grad at diff==0 is +1 (where(0<=diff,1,-1)); torch uses sign -> 0. Also writes target grad = -input grad.

families.family: flash attention forward (Triton tutorial v2 copy)
families.reference: F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, is_causal=causal, scale=sm_scale) for q,k,v [Z,H,N,D]; aux L = log2-domain logsumexp: (sm_scale*log2(e)*q@k^T).logsumexp-in-base-2 per row (m + log2 l)
families.notes: DEPRECATED: MultiheadAttention.__init__ raises 'currently deprecated'; layer also hard-codes sm_scale=0.5 (not 1/sqrt(D)) and passes non-contiguous transposed q/k/v while kernel computes offsets as off_hz*stride_qh//stride_qm (assumes contiguous [Z,H,N,D]). No bounds checks: N must be a multiple of 128, D in {16,32,64,128}, q and kv same length. q pre-scaled and cast to input dtype before dot. Requires cc>=8 (raises otherwise); BLOCK 128x64, num_stages=4 may exceed sm86 99KB smem for D=128.

families.reference: (o.float() * do.float()).sum(-1)
families.notes: Assumes contiguous [Z*H*N, D] and N multiple of 128; unmasked loads. Deprecated with the attention module.

families.reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q,k,v,is_causal=causal,scale=sm_scale), (q,k,v), do)
families.notes: Recomputes P from forward L and preprocess Delta (must be the forward's outputs). dq accumulated read-modify-write into caller-zeroed buffer; sequence_parallel=True writes per-column-block dq replicas summed in Python. MMA_V3 only on cc>=9 (else transposed-dot path). BLOCK=128, num_warps=8, D up to 128 may exceed sm86 smem. Deprecated.
